card.text: Planet 1.6 times Earth’s radius on a 385 day orbit around a Sun-like star.

introduction.text: Kepler-452 b is 1.63 times as wide as Earth and circles a Sun-like star every 385 days. Only its size and orbit are measured; here it is a plain sphere in its star's light.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A gray sphere of the measured radius. No colour, surface or atmosphere of this planet is observed.
